query:
-- Outpatient Appointment Audit Report
-- Shows all modifications and cancellations to outpatient appointments
-- Each row represents a change event with both current and previous appointment details
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
-- Change event details
change_number as "Change number",
-- Current appointment details (at time of report)
to_char(((appointment_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Appointment date and time",
appointment_type as "Appointment type",
clinician as "Clinician",
location_group as "Area",
priority as "Priority appointment",
is_repeating as "Repeating appointment",
-- Modification details
created_by as "Appointment created by",
modified_by as "Appointment modified by",
to_char(((modified_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Appointment modified date & time",
is_cancelled as "Appointment cancelled",
-- Previous appointment details (prior to changes)
to_char(((prev_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Previous appointment date & time",
prev_appointment_type as "Previous appointment type",
prev_clinician as "Previous clinician",
prev_location_group as "Previous area",
prev_priority as "Previous priority appointment"
from "reporting"."ds__outpatient_appointments_audit"
where
-- Date range filter on appointment datetime
((appointment_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and
((appointment_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
-- Facility filter
and
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
order by display_id, appointment_id, change_number
name: Audit - outpatient appointments
notes: This report shows an audit log of all modifications and cancellations to outpatient appointments. Each row represents a change event, showing both the current appointment details and the previous values before the change. The report is designed to track which Tamanu users are creating and editing appointments. Status-only changes (e.g., Confirmed to Arrived) are excluded unless the status change is to Cancelled. If an appointment is changed multiple times, each modification will appear as a separate line.
